evidence_text: Twenty-eight of 312 patients (9.0%) in the Drug X group and 47 of 315 (14.9%) in the placebo group died within 28 days (RR 0.60, 95% CI 0.39 to 0.92; p=0.018).
Mortality was reduced by Drug X (RR 0.62, 95% CI 0.40-0.96).
